data.narrative: The student successfully orchestrated a parallel 3-agent development sprint by establishing strict interface contracts upfront. They demonstrated advanced systems thinking by diagnosing a cross-feature communication gap (pub/sub vs. middleware) and bridging it with a system-level integration contract and targeted glue code.

dimension_scores.observation: Drafted comprehensive interface contracts preventing schema collisions across parallel agents.
dimension_scores.evidence: Defined strict CREATES, READS, MODIFIES boundaries and authored a minimal glue prompt for event translation.

dimension_scores.observation: Rigorously tested cross-feature integration to uncover missing data flows.
dimension_scores.evidence: Identified that Agent 1's pub/sub events were being ignored by Agent 3's HTTP middleware during Level 2 integration testing.

dimension_scores.observation: Resolved complex integration bugs with minimal friction.
dimension_scores.evidence: Used a precise glue-code prompt instead of forcing either agent into an expensive rewrite loop.

dimension_scores.observation: Made critical architectural decisions prioritizing systemic stability over unchecked speed.
dimension_scores.evidence: Chose the 'Interface-First' coordination strategy, correctly anticipating that 'Branch-and-Merge' would cause catastrophic shared-state conflicts.

dimension_scores.observation: Shipped a highly complex, multi-feature integration safely.
dimension_scores.evidence: Full test suite passed, verifying flawless data flow between @mentions, comments, and the system audit log.

strengths: Advanced parallel orchestration of AI agents
data.recommendation: Maintain this high standard of system-level integration contracts for all future distributed AI workflows.

public_evidence.student_action: Coordinated a 3-agent parallel sprint by defining strict interface boundaries, then authored integration glue mapping pub/sub events to HTTP middleware.
public_evidence.technical_detail: Event subscriber mapping 'comment.created' payloads to 'auditLog.record()' method.
public_evidence.proof: Cross-feature test suite passed successfully; audit logs accurately record nested comment creation.
public_evidence.reviewer_value: Demonstrates the candidate's ability to scale AI engineering workflows by managing concurrent agents without triggering shared-state merge conflicts.

concepts_demonstrated.evidence: Recognized that contracts must dictate data flow/handshake mechanisms (how components communicate), not just data schemas (what they produce).

teaching_approaches.detail: Executed a 3-level verification strategy (individual, cross-feature, conflict detection) to expose hidden integration gaps.
